name: Wuhua
source: Wuhua County Natural Resources Bureau is the evidenced local custodian for natural resources and real-estate registration information; no public anonymous parcel feature service was qualified.

queries.query: Wuhua County Meizhou China official natural resources bureau cadastral map parcel GIS
queries.result: Search found the official Wuhua County Natural Resources Bureau page and the official Guangdong Tianditu public geospatial portal. The county bureau page establishes the local custodian, but no Wuhua-specific public cadastral parcel viewer or downloadable parcel feature service was found in the indexed official results.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Wuhua County Natural Resources Bureau / Wuhua County People's Government
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Official county department portal with natural-resources and real-estate-registration notices, including cadastral-related public work. It is a custodian/information page, not a parcel geometry API.

Official information-disclosure guide identifies the bureau and says cadastral certificate statistics are among proactively disclosed information; it also says real-estate-registration materials are subject to special access rules. No parcel geometry endpoint is published.

officialAndRelevantLeads.operator: Guangdong Provincial Natural Resources geospatial public-service platform
officialAndRelevantLeads.observation: Current public portal exposes general map, imagery, thematic and catalog resources. It does not, from the inspected public configuration, identify a Wuhua cadastral parcel layer.
Current thematic application JavaScript was inspected. Its public WFS configuration returned an XZPOI geocoding service, not a cadastral parcel service.

requestsAndEndpointChecks.status: timeout after 20 seconds in research environment
requestsAndEndpointChecks.summary: Direct official county department page request timed out; indexed official search result was used only for custodian discovery. No retry with credentials or alternate private access was attempted.

Official information-disclosure guide was identified by search and its indexed text reviewed; direct fetch was unavailable in this environment. It provides procedure/custodian evidence, not parcel geometry.
Current Guangdong Tianditu portal HTML fetched. Public links include the thematic application and resource/catalog pages; no Wuhua parcel service was listed in the inspected portal HTML.

Current thematic application HTML and referenced JavaScript/configuration were fetched anonymously. WFS support is present, but no Wuhua cadastral layer was exposed in the page/configuration inspected.

Bounded anonymous configuration request returned one XZPOI geocoding service with safe point/name fields. It was not a parcel service; no parcel schema, native parcel ID, or parcel geometry was returned.
Application-relative endpoint guess failed; this route failure is not evidence of cadastral absence.
